formula: the hero: its pattern, and the one element that dominates the first screen
then each section in order: its ground by word (canvas, tint, accent or pattern), the component it holds, and the one element that dominates it
which blocks are unequal: the feature components that span the content column, and the one set of peers that sits as equal cards
which facts take the supplied fact role
rhythm, only through the step names supplied
rules: spacing and radius only as step names (space-8, borderRadius-500) or their var(--…) form, never px
name every supplied section role in order, and place every component name in one of them
follow the supplied grounds exactly, one per section in order; name them by word and never by color variable
an accent ground holds only a component whose roles include accent
one paragraph with no line breaks
a section with no supplied component is led by a kind of element (a member quotation, a photograph, the submit action), never by a count, statistic or result, since the inputs supply no figures

output.paragraph: A contained page that opens on a centred hero, the pattern ground, where the workshop date is the largest thing on the screen. The detail list sits on the tint ground and holds the slots as equal cards, each led by its time in display3, before a short form on the canvas.
